release_games.name: FRUIT CATCH: TWO BASKETS
release_games.description: Catch the right fruit with two baskets! Play with a friend and control one basket each, or take on both baskets alone for a fast-paced multitasking challenge.

release_games.name: RIVER OF DEAD
release_games.description: Play as a lone warrior dog defending a vital river from relentless crocodiles in a fast-paced 2D arcade survival game. Master your harpoon, unlock the Power Harpoon, survive the Final Rush, and defeat the River King with 8 direct hits.

release_games.name: OUTVOTE - Steam Version
release_games.description: How many of your friends would say yes? Answer questions in secret, then guess how the room voted – or call every player's answer. Play with Steam friends, or with anyone in the browser. Free, up to 20 players.

release_games.name: My Little Black Hole
release_games.description: A quiet pixel-art desktop companion. Let a little black hole absorb stress objects, discover planets and constellations, and arrange a universe of your own while you work or take a break.

release_games.name: CLOUD PATROL
release_games.description: Fly across floating islands, hold off swarming drones, and face down three colossal bosses. Earn coins, unlock stronger firepower, and climb the endless Ascension ladder. This sky is yours to guard. Dive into a fast, exhilarating wave-based first-person aerial shooter.

release_games.name: Retro Mix 8: Arcade Collection
release_games.description: Remember the little games that filled whole afternoons? Retro Mix 8 brings eight familiar games together in one single-player arcade collection, from tank defense and fish-eat-fish to tile linking and brick breaking. Come back for one more round!

release_games.name: Cards Rumble: Clash Of Elements
release_games.description: Cards Rumble: Clash of Elements is a fast-paced competitive strategy card game where Fire, Ice, and Venom collide. Unleash flames, freeze your opponent, and spread venom. Read every move, control the battlefield, and strike at the perfect moment. One decision can turn the tide of battle.

release_games.name: Emoji : Tidy Up
release_games.description: Sort, match, and organize a colorful world of emojis! Discover 2,100 adorable emoji characters, solve relaxing sorting puzzles, and turn chaos into perfect order. Enjoy a cozy and satisfying experience where every move brings joy. Create your own tidy emoji collection!

release_games.name: Circle to another motion
release_games.description: Your physical intuition will be put to the test. Connect the disc to objects using links and alter its circular motion to guide the target into the box.

release_games.name: Junkpot
release_games.description: A roguelike about bidding on random storage crates. Read the odds, buy the crate, then stack charms that multiply what falls out. Type combos, rarity bonuses and odds boosts compound into one engine. Build it fast - the quota doubles every round.

release_games.name: Rogue Links
release_games.description: Drive the ball. Fight your way to it. Rogue Links is a top-down action roguelite where every shot is a tradeoff: longer drives save strokes but unleash more monsters. Play the Campaign, Onslaught, the Endless Gauntlet, Daily runs and Head-to-Head, or build and share your own courses.

release_games.name: Checkmate: The Red General’s Last Move
release_games.description: Checkmate is a turn-based Xiangqi roguelite where a lone red general carries a cannon into a 9×10 battlefield. Move to reload, fire risky snap shots, aim for precision, and use enemy pieces as firing screens. Each upgrade also strengthens the opposing army.

release_games.name: Hideout Heist
release_games.description: A co-op horror heist for 1–4 players. Break into a store after dark, grab fragile physics loot and haul it out before the night shift gets you. Hide in the shadows, outsmart guards and worse, and make the quota. The building is different every night. The fun is the same - brand best.

release_games.name: Primal One
release_games.description: Primal one is a first-person dinosaur survival horror set in an installation in the cretaceous period. Hide and evade dinosaurs that are hunting you, while you try to find a way to go back to the present alive or contact survivors in other installation.

release_games.name: Pucked Up
release_games.description: The oddball hockey deckbuilder. Construct your roster, customize your playbook, and survive a season against teams that will do anything to cheat their way to victory. Outsmart your competition, make the playoffs, and hoist the cup in a league where every run is unique.

release_games.name: ShredDead
release_games.description: ShredDead is a quirky relaxing incremental zombie-shredding game focused on progression with no lose conditions. Defeat endless waves, collect loot, grow your skill tree and evolve the zombies.

release_games.name: Punch Upon a Time
release_games.description: Punch Upon a Time is a team-based party fighter inspired by Smash Bros where you take on rounds of modes, mini-games, and combat alongside your friends. Assemble a squad of the biggest fairy tale names to punch, dunk, fly, score, and sumo your way to victory as the LAST TEAM STANDING.

release_games.name: Formation Builder Idle
release_games.description: Every hero changes the heroes beside it. Arrange 46+ heroes on a grid, chain their abilities, and find the layout that multiplies your damage. Then prestige across 21 worlds, fight with mounts, and run missions, mines and a workshop while you're away.

release_games.name: Iskabon
release_games.description: A cursed game demo just merged with your PC's OS. Take part in a high-stakes roguelite deckbuilder with a Russian Roulette twist. Push your luck, trigger wild card synergies, and defeat the glitch to free your computer before the system melts.

release_games.name: Arctic Roll
release_games.description: Embark on a relaxing turn-based tactical roguelite adventure. Lead your team of explorers, face dangerous encounters, uncover mysterious artifacts, and unravel the secret behind a strange signal.

release_games.name: Giggleland
release_games.description: Tolie isn’t allowed to leave the house. One night she wakes up alone in Giggleland, to a voice over the park speakers: her father is waiting for her at the information booth. A first-person psychological horror game in eight chapters. This game is not suitable for children.

release_games.name: Greyward: Castaway Survival
release_games.description: Wash ashore on a misty island, build a camp and survive the Grey: a night mist that burns. Climb endless rune towers, break the Grey camps and free their chiefs, sail to eight far islands, and play solo or in Steam co-op with up to four castaways.

release_games.name: Frantic Far West
release_games.description: A saloon, cowboys, a sheriff, an outlaw, a table and revolvers. The perfect setting for a frantic debate, with just one question: who will shoot? Deductions, lies, surprises and laughter are all part of this online hidden-role game for 4 to 12 players.

release_games.name: Give Us Back Gravity
release_games.description: A zero-gravity push-your-luck roguelite about salvaging a derelict space station. There are no brakes: thrusters burn oxygen, so you stop by kicking off walls or throwing cargo the other way. Take all you can carry, but it only pays if you get it back to the airlock. Online co-op for up to 4.

release_games.name: Project Neko
release_games.description: Pilot a cat-shaped ship through a neon rhythm tunnel. Hit, hold and trace notes to the beat, chase high scores, and take a loud, unruly cat band from rehearsal room to stage. Unlock partners and songs across four difficulties in this music-driven arcade adventure.

release_games.name: Quiz Bang!
release_games.description: 《Quiz Bang! 》is a first-person party shooter for 2–6 players. On this not-so-safe TV show, answer questions or beat minigames to earn ammo. Take on another challenge, or turn around and shoot your friends? A friendly reminder: watch your back while answering.

release_games.name: Shear line
release_games.description: A physics-based lockpicking simulator with no dice rolls or hidden checks. Learn how cylinder, combination, and disc-detainer locks work, then put your lockpicking skills to the test.

release_games.name: Behind the Corner
release_games.description: Explore dark vintage environments and survive encounters with a relentless entity in this first-person psychological horror game. Listen closely, watch the shadows, and face the unsettling feeling that something is waiting just around the corner.

release_games.name: My Stylish Life
release_games.description: It's 2008, and you just sat down at the family computer. Run your own boutique, build your dream wardrobe, make new friends, fall in love, and explore a colorful world where every day is yours to style. Welcome to My Stylish Life.

release_games.name: FUTA GIRLS
release_games.description: FUTA GIRLS - is a simple 2D game for adults in which you have to uncover hot images of beautiful ladies.

release_games.name: Shatterwing
release_games.description: Turn enemy fire into your greatest weapon. SHATTERWING is a pixel-art bullet hell shooter where you dash to create mirrors, reflect deadly volleys, and build your ship across five stages. Master six ships or switch colors and absorb bullets in Polarity mode.

release_games.name: SHAME
release_games.description: SHAME, A Survival Horror Game, Where Player must survive through the night against vampire like creatures. Gear up with the vast amount of weapons to slay these beast, shop for ammo and resources , and try your best to survive through the night.

release_games.name: GomokuSoccer
release_games.description: Place or Flick? In Gomoku Soccer, you can place your stones just to build a line of five, or flick them off the board and watch your opponent crashing out. Test your strategy and your aim!

release_games.name: Echoes of Pinebridge
release_games.description: After a transfer student enters his life, college senior Kent begins suffering fainting spells and hearing voices. Navigate friendships, secrets, and a growing supernatural mystery in this choice-driven visual novel.

release_games.name: Dealer's Choice
release_games.description: Three roguelites at one table. Drop balls through a plinko board, roll dice for poker hands, bet against a roulette wheel you rebuild as you play — then push your luck for one more floor, one more roll, one more spin. The Dealer is watching.

release_games.name: らくがきスマッシュ / Doodle Smash
release_games.description: Your doodle is your fighter! Draw a character and watch it brawl in a knockout-style party fighter. Its size, shape and colours decide its stats and one of 30 elemental skills. Play up to 4 on one screen, battle the CPU, or climb the online ranked Colosseum against doodles from around the world.

release_games.name: Watershed
release_games.description: Rain on real terrain and watch the rivers run. Drain the oceans to the Ice Age and the Persian Gulf becomes a valley. Roll the atlas back to 3000 BC, then send a caravan across what remains. An educational sandbox on real elevation data, with its sources on every layer.

release_games.name: Amazecards
release_games.description: Each card represents a movement. Choosing the correct sequence is essential to cross the board, avoid dangers, and reach the chest at the end of each stage. One wrong step can cause the player to fall into holes or be struck by spike traps that alternate between active and inactive every turn.

release_games.name: Abandoned Hearts
release_games.description: Abandoned Hearts is a single-player detective horror game. Investigate a fatal castle fire, connect clues on an evidence board, and draw your own conclusions. Run, hide, and distract what stalks the halls. The families need answers. You need to make it out alive.

release_games.name: Ashnar's Lair
release_games.description: A traditional roguelike built around your character. Unlock seven classes by your deeds, grow them through three talent trees and hunt gear with rolled affixes. Elite foes and whole dungeons roll affixes too, and every one changes how you fight. One life per run. Will you defeat Ashnar?

release_games.name: Play and Learn: German
release_games.description: First we get you speaking, then we make you better. A story RPG where the microphone is the controller: a full A1 to B2 German course, 15 role-play rooms, 6,100 spoken sentences, every meaning in your own language. Fully offline, one-time purchase.

release_games.name: Jessica's Choices - Forced [Episode 1]
release_games.description: Your story continues right where Origins left off. Whether Jessica finds herself wandering the streets alone, caught in George’s web of deceit, or trapped in the unsettling confines of Margaret Thatuals under Professor Trounch’s watchful gaze and the orderlies, every choice matters.

release_games.name: Lighthouse of Madness
release_games.description: Embark on this Lovecraft-inspired tale and discover the mysteries that await you on this island. Explore the island, solve challenging puzzles, and most importantly: try not to lose your sanity.

release_games.name: Fzzy Bzzy's The Beautiful Ones
release_games.description: A straight forward action rpg where you play as Shell, a mouse destined to lead sinking mice out of the dark! Based around the Universe 25 experiment, a dying society of rats and mice fight to survive in a post-apocalyptic world!

release_games.name: Bird Empire
release_games.description: Build a legendary bird farm in a cozy idle game. Collect six bird species, sell eggs, fulfill customer orders, develop new facilities, earn offline income, and begin new cycles to unlock permanent bonuses for your growing empire.

release_games.name: Folk-Tography
release_games.description: Folk-Tography is a 4-player co-op cryptid photography extraction game. Photograph legendary creatures, investigate paranormal anomalies, manage scarce resources, and survive various dangers to escape with the evidence before the valley consumes you.

release_games.name: Bunny Hopper
release_games.description: Bunny Hopper is a fast-paced 3D platformer where every move counts! Master wall-running, dashes, and jumps, dodge deadly traps, and shoot targets without slowing down. Control a combat robot, conquer challenging courses, and put your reflexes to the test!

release_games.name: GORA
release_games.description: Your harvest has a health bar. Defend it as a gun-toting pumpkin in this colorful action roguelite. Dodge monster waves, upgrade your weapons and turn defeated foes into fertilizer. Survive the night, save your crops and unlock your next guardian.

release_games.name: Just Pancake Simulator
release_games.description: A short physics-based cooking game about making pancakes for someone you love. Flip, burn, drop, and somehow serve the perfect stack.

release_games.name: Homegrown: Sports Agent Empire
release_games.description: Build a sports agency empire from your hometown up. Sign stars across basketball, football, baseball and hockey, negotiate under real salary-cap rules, fill your trophy case with career honors, and climb the monthly global leaderboard. One price. Twenty seasons. Zero microtransactions.

release_games.name: Anomaly Jobs : Death Row
release_games.description: Same Path again and again. Everything looks familiar, until it does not. Some Anomalies hide in plain sight. Some are hard to spot. Find them, then take the correct exit. Every wrong choice lets the night draw closer.

release_games.name: Reborn a Zombie 2: Entwined Hearts
release_games.description: In this sequel of the LGBT visual novel Reborn a Zombie, Dawn, a trans girl turned zombie, now has to confront her past. However, the Demon King is approaching and his presence will change everything.

release_games.name: Scribble Tanks
release_games.description: Scribble Tanks is a survival roguelite on a sketch-styled 3D battlefield on graph paper. Fight zombie hordes, tanks and bosses, build your arsenal, reclaim besieged regions, and face the final boss—or keep fighting in Endless Mode.

release_games.name: RetroHub
release_games.description: A 1994 interactive-TV terminal, drawn pixel by pixel. Dial a number and play: backgammon, Yum dice, hangman, bowling, pinball, brick-breaker, Bizz-Billes… Solo, with friends around one screen, or online.

release_games.name: Headbutt Dino
release_games.description: A roguelite deckbuilder about a headbutting dinosaur. I wanted the thrill of blasting obstacles away, not dodging them. The higher your combo, the denser they get, and active cards are there to just feel good to fire off. Every stage ends with a boss. Ten stages to a run, as currently designed.

release_games.name: Crypto Market Rivals
release_games.description: Find your trading style in a single-player game with simulated funds. Explore markets, revisit crypto history, build a Wild run, and grow a career at your own pace.

release_games.name: GRIDMINE
release_games.description: GRIDMINE is a short, retro tower defense built around incremental progression. Survive for as long as possible, then return to your skill tree to spend extracted resources on tower-based upgrades and abilities.

release_games.name: First Principles: A Calculus Platformer
release_games.description: Run and jump across the graphs of real functions. Every level is a curve — its derivative shapes the platforms and hazards. 40+ stages from parabolas to Riemann sums, AP Calculus BC, physics, and aerospace curves, ending in a Mandelbrot boss. A platformer that teaches real calculus.

release_games.name: Nothing Simulator
release_games.description: A game about doing absolutely nothing. Stare at a black screen, watch a timer and prove that time is still passing

release_games.name: Volleyball Mania
release_games.description: Volleyball Mania is a 3D beach and indoor volleyball game. Pass, set, spike, read the block, aim past the defender, and finish the rally. Take on the World Tour across three stadiums, or challenge a friend online.

release_games.name: Looks Like It Fits
release_games.description: A cargo-packing puzzle about making an awkward load survive the road. Keep ice cold, warm a dragon egg and strap down fragile parcels. Study the route, arrange your truck bed, then watch your plan face bumps, braking and changing weather across 40 deliveries.

release_games.name: Hero Football Manager
release_games.description: Run a small football club where ordinary players can wake up with superpowers. Train the squad, hire staff, upgrade the ground and keep the books. Then watch your plan play out in pixel-art matches.

release_games.name: GRID64
release_games.description: Minimalist pixel-art chess in pure black and white. Solve mate puzzles, face an engine that thinks up to 8 moves ahead, or play strangers worldwide in rated matches and arena tournaments where the champion wins a golden card.

release_games.name: Buying Time
release_games.description: skill-based bets! You have a limited amount of time but with this you can win more. Use powerful upgrades to further increase your time pool because when it hits zero, it's game over. Things are not as simple as they seem.

release_games.name: Belgo Odyssey
release_games.description: Belgo Odyssey is an absurdly Belgian 2D action-arcade game. Aboard the airship Albert, travel across the country, battle Sputnik drones, Panzercopies, bizarre creatures, and very Belgian bosses. Collect beers, eat fries, and try to save Belgium.

release_games.name: Winter Creatures 2
release_games.description: Winter Creatures 2 is the sequel to the original 3D puzzle game, taking you to an unexplored world blanketed in snow and shrouded in mystery. It is home to little creatures that need your help!

release_games.name: Court of Lies
release_games.description: Lies are easier to tell than to hide. In this 5–10 player medieval deduction game you sit at the same table, speak, and watch the hands that seal every decree. Some among you serve the Dark Heir — and they want the crown to fall.

release_games.name: Tales of the Immortal Path
release_games.description: One sword breaks all arts, one thought attains immortality. Tales of the Immortal Path is an ink-wash xianxia single-player card roguelike. Countless artifacts and cards. Trample the heavens and seek the Dao of immortality!

release_games.name: Steel & Fortune
release_games.description: Build a party, bring home loot, and return stronger. Run an adventurers’ guild in this real-time auto-battle RPG: prepare gear, skills, formations and routes. Combat is automatic by default; optionally control one member and switch back anytime. Take on a six-chapter campaign and adventures beyond t

release_games.name: The Great Game of Cards
release_games.description: A turn-based strategy card game where everyone can draft from the same card pool, but what you build and how you play them is up to you. Draft your deck, fight your friends, and... boom. CARDS

release_games.name: A Lot Of Steps
release_games.description: A spiky hill has emerged in front of you. As a curious hillbilly, you have to find out what's on the other side of the hill.

release_games.name: Puzzle Jungle
release_games.description: This game is a classic puzzle game with multiple levels and beautiful graphics. Enjoy!

release_games.name: Puzzle Dolphins
release_games.description: This game is a classic puzzle game with multiple levels and beautiful graphics. Enjoy!

release_games.name: The Mayor’s Hand
release_games.description: Build the city, manage resources and services, shape your deck, and face new pressures every quarter. In The Mayor’s Hand, every decision shapes your administration: keep Public Trust high and make it to election day.

release_games.name: Puzzle Fireworks
release_games.description: This game is a classic puzzle game with multiple levels and beautiful graphics. Enjoy!

release_games.name: Yatai 8
release_games.description: An endless loop in a dark Japanese corridor. Observe every detail carefully: if everything looks normal, keep walking. If you notice even the slightest anomaly, turn back immediately. Escape the loop before it's too late.

release_games.name: Nekomancer
release_games.description: Play as a heavily armed cat and unleash a storm of bullets on enemy hordes in a bullet-heaven roguelite. Explore countless combinations of weapons, perks and passive abilities to build something new each run. Fight bosses across procedurally generated maps.

release_games.name: Puzzle Crustaceans
release_games.description: This game is a classic puzzle game with multiple levels and beautiful graphics. Enjoy!

release_games.name: Puzzle Fire
release_games.description: This game is a classic puzzle game with multiple levels and beautiful graphics. Enjoy!

release_games.name: Puzzle Beetles
release_games.description: This game is a classic puzzle game with multiple levels and beautiful graphics. Enjoy!

release_games.name: Puzzle Butterflies
release_games.description: This game is a classic puzzle game with multiple levels and beautiful graphics. Enjoy!

release_games.name: Hentai Tales: Profane Arbitration
release_games.description: You are a "Secret Liaison Mediator" in Tokyo's underworld. Clients hire you to stage affairs, fulfilling their deepest NTR fantasies. But this game of desire is a double-edged sword. Every encounter is a performance, every target a mystery.

release_games.name: Fresh Stacker
release_games.description: A fast-paced, highly customizable tetromino stacking game featuring competitive multiplayer and everything you need to sharpen your skills, from guided opener practice to powerful custom training modes.

release_games.name: SpudFall
release_games.description: Real-time potato artillery chaos for 1–4 players. Blast the terrain, ride the wind, be the last spud standing.

release_games.name: Supplant
release_games.description: Chess, but capture transforms the captor. Your queen takes a pawn and your queen is now a pawn. Kings excepted. Standard rules otherwise, with ranked matches, puzzles, bots, and analysis. Sometimes the strongest move on the board is forcing your opponent to capture something.

release_games.name: Open Sourcerer
release_games.description: Open Sourcerer was a 2D platformer where players created and customized their spells in JavaScript.

release_games.name: The Grounds-Keeper
release_games.description: Death has retired from collecting souls, and now he keeps the grounds. Mowing grass by lantern light, scrubbing centuries of moss from forgotten headstones, and vacuum autumn leaves into oblivion across fifteen moonlit plots. A cozy isometric chore game with no timers, no enemies, and no stress.

release_games.name: Leafman
release_games.description: The Mother Oak is forgetting. The Blight has made the guardians of her memories forget who they are, so she lets her last leaf fall. Be that leaf. Leafman scatters on the wind and strikes like a storm across seven realms in this 2D pixel-art action platformer.

release_games.name: Astrowar
release_games.description: AstroWar is a fast 2D multiplayer space arena shooter. Create quick lobbies, customize your ship, add bots, dodge meteorites, grab power-ups, and fight through chaotic battles across a wide starfield.

release_games.name: Madcar Multiplayer
release_games.description: One rule : Press the pedal ! Madcar: Multiplayer brings together the craziest drivers ! Enjoy the funniest online races !

methodology: Steam公开资料未提供可核实的商店首次上架时间。首次发现时间不等于实际上架时间，可能因搜索顺位变化而首次进入样本。
第一次完整待发售快照建立基线，不计入近1/7/30天新增；之后首次进入观察范围的待发售作品才计为本站新发现。
待发售与已发售按商店状态分开。发售窗口按北京时间自然日计算：近1天为采集当天，近7天含当天及此前6天，近30天含当天及此前29天。
最近发售优先使用首次可玩发售日期，含抢先体验首次发售；已知抢先体验转正式而首次日期不明的作品不计入最近发售。
每天更新一次、完整快照缓存23小时；来源失败保留旧数据及原时间，旧资料不计入当前新增或新发售筛选。
近期发售入口有条数上限，可能在覆盖30天之前达到上限。页面展示所采到的样本，不宣称全库完整。
